business_problem: We see Chip as a very exciting start to an exciting journey. Adoption will continue to grow, as will the power of these models—enabling us to go and solve our customers biggest problems.
solution_summary: We see Chip as a very exciting start to an exciting journey. Adoption will continue to grow, as will the power of these models—enabling us to go and solve our customers biggest problems. Howdens deployed the Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service with other Azure tools to create a tool that can be queried using natural language in a chat interface. “Last year has really allowed us to hone in on our business model,” says David Sturdee, Chief Customer Officer at Howdens. “This has allowed us, in turn, to become the trade’s first choice when it comes to kitchens.” Howdens used Azure AI Search, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI Service to support enterprise knowledge search with a governed operating model that connected the relevant data sources, automation logic, and employee-facing experiences without custom point-to-point tooling.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves grounded context for search and copilot experiences.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies language, vision, and other AI APIs that classify, interpret, or enrich source content.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Provides large language model inference for natural language search, drafting, summarization, and recommendations.

data_flow: Content from enterprise documents and knowledge sources is ingested into Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Services, where it is indexed, enriched, or reasoned over before grounded answers are returned to employees through business applications.
